items_flat.title_en: Cursor closes acquisition by SpaceX, joins SpaceXAI to advance Grok
items_flat.title_zh: Cursor 正式完成被 SpaceX 收購，加入 SpaceXAI 團隊強化 Grok
items_flat.summary_en: Cursor announced that its acquisition by SpaceX has officially closed. The team will join SpaceXAI to help make Grok the world’s most useful AI and improve Grok Build, Grok Bot, the Grok API, and Cursor itself.
items_flat.summary_zh: Cursor 宣布其被 SpaceX 的收購已正式完成。團隊將加入 SpaceXAI，協助讓 Grok 成為世界上最有用的 AI，並改進 Grok Build、Grok Bot、Grok API 與 Cursor 本身。
items_flat.analysis_en: This integrates one of the leading AI coding agents directly into the SpaceXAI/Grok stack, potentially accelerating distribution, data feedback loops, and agent capabilities. The strategic fit is clear for software-engineering agents, though long-term product independence and compute allocation remain open questions.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這將領先的 AI coding agent 直接整合進 SpaceXAI/Grok 生態，可能加速分發、資料回饋迴路與 agent 能力。對軟體工程 agent 的策略契合度很高，但產品長期獨立性與算力分配仍待觀察。
items_flat.quote: Cursor is now part of @SpaceX. Today, we have officially closed our acquisition. We will join the @SpaceXAI team to help make Grok the world's most useful AI and improve Grok Build, Grok Bot, Grok API, Cursor, and more.
items_flat.quote_zh: Cursor 現在是 @SpaceX 的一部分。今天我們已正式完成收購。我們將加入 @SpaceXAI 團隊，協助讓 Grok 成為世界上最有用的 AI，並改進 Grok Build、Grok Bot、Grok API、Cursor 等。

items_flat.title_en: Google launches Gemini 3.7 Flash, its most capable workhorse model for coding and agents
items_flat.title_zh: Google 推出 Gemini 3.7 Flash，最強工作馬型模型，聚焦 coding 與 agent
items_flat.summary_en: Google DeepMind released Gemini 3.7 Flash, described as its most intelligent workhorse model yet for coding and agents. It delivers substantial gains over 3.6 Flash on coding benchmarks (FrontierCode 43.6% vs 34.4%, DeepSWE 65.3% vs 49.0%) and is offered at an introductory half-price of $0.75/$3.75 per million tokens through end-2026.
items_flat.summary_zh: Google DeepMind 發布 Gemini 3.7 Flash，稱為迄今最強工作馬型模型，專攻 coding 與 agent。相較 3.6 Flash 在 coding 基準大幅提升（FrontierCode 43.6% vs 34.4%、DeepSWE 65.3% vs 49.0%），並提供至 2026 年底的半價導入價 $0.75/$3.75 每百萬 token。
items_flat.analysis_en: Rapid iteration on the Flash line (3.5→3.7 in three months) keeps Google competitive on cost-sensitive agent workloads. The price cut plus measurable coding gains lower the barrier for production agents, though long-term pricing after the intro period will determine sustained adoption.
items_flat.analysis_zh: Flash 系列快速迭代（三個月內 3.5→3.7）讓 Google 在成本敏感的 agent 工作負載保持競爭力。降價加上明確的 coding 提升降低生產級 agent 門檻，但導入期後的長期定價將決定持續採用度。
items_flat.quote: Gemini 3.7 Flash is our most intelligent workhorse model yet for coding and agents.
items_flat.quote_zh: Gemini 3.7 Flash 是我們迄今最強的工作馬型模型，專為 coding 與 agent 打造。

items_flat.title_en: OpenAI previews Ultrafast mode for GPT-5.6 Sol, up to 14× faster via Cerebras
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI 預覽 GPT-5.6 Sol Ultrafast 模式，Cerebras 最高加速 14 倍
items_flat.summary_en: OpenAI announced Ultrafast mode for GPT-5.6 Sol, delivering up to 14× the speed of standard processing and up to 750 output tokens per second, powered by Cerebras. It launches first in the OpenAI API to a select group of customers, with broader access as capacity expands.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI 宣布 GPT-5.6 Sol 的 Ultrafast 模式，速度最高達標準處理的 14 倍，並可達每秒 750 個 output token，由 Cerebras 提供支援。首先在 OpenAI API 向精選客戶推出，隨產能擴張再擴大存取。
items_flat.analysis_en: Ultra-low-latency frontier inference opens real-time use cases (voice, interactive coding, support) that were previously impractical. Success depends on how quickly capacity scales beyond the initial select group and whether the speed premium justifies the cost for most workloads.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 超低延遲的前沿推理開啟先前不切實際的即時用例（語音、互動 coding、客服）。成敗取決於產能擴張速度，以及速度溢價對多數工作負載是否值得。
items_flat.quote: Previewing Ultrafast mode: GPT-5.6 Sol at up to 14x the speed. Launching first in the OpenAI API to a select group of customers with expanded access to more businesses as capacity grows.
items_flat.quote_zh: 預覽 Ultrafast 模式：GPT-5.6 Sol 最高 14 倍速度。首先在 OpenAI API 向精選客戶推出，隨產能成長再擴及更多企業。

items_flat.title_en: OpenAI appoints Dali Rajic as Chief Revenue Officer
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI 任命 Dali Rajic 為首席營收長
items_flat.summary_en: OpenAI named Dali Rajic (formerly President & COO of Wiz) as Chief Revenue Officer to lead its global revenue organization. He succeeds Denise Dresser, who is departing after a transition period.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI 任命前 Wiz 總裁暨營運長 Dali Rajic 為首席營收長，領導全球營收組織。他接替 Denise Dresser，後者將在過渡期後離職。
items_flat.analysis_en: The appointment signals continued focus on enterprise scale and go-to-market discipline amid rapid revenue growth and executive turnover. It comes as OpenAI prepares for a potential public listing and faces intensifying competition on commercial deployment.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 此任命顯示在營收快速成長與高階異動之際，OpenAI 持續聚焦企業規模化與 go-to-market 紀律。時機點正值潛在上市準備與商業部署競爭加劇。
items_flat.quote: Dali will build the revenue operating system needed to scale for this next phase.
items_flat.quote_zh: Dali 將打造擴展下一階段所需的營收作業系統。

items_flat.title_en: ChatGPT desktop on Mac gains Computer History feature
items_flat.title_zh: ChatGPT Mac 桌面版新增 Computer History 功能
items_flat.summary_en: OpenAI rolled out Computer History, an opt-in feature in the ChatGPT desktop app on Mac that lets the model remember activity across selected apps and websites. It builds a timeline and can suggest skills or automations from recurring tasks, with privacy controls including pause and selective inclusion.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI 在 ChatGPT Mac 桌面版推出 Computer History 選擇性功能，讓模型記住選定 App 與網站的活動。它建立時間軸，並可從重複任務建議技能或自動化，同時提供暫停與選擇性納入等隱私控制。
items_flat.analysis_en: Moving from screenshot-based Chronicle to accessibility-event history reduces friction and privacy concerns while enabling deeper personalization. Adoption will hinge on user trust in the opt-in controls and whether the context actually reduces explanation burden in daily workflows.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 從以截圖為主的 Chronicle 轉向無障礙事件歷史，降低摩擦與隱私疑慮，同時啟用更深個人化。採用度取決於用戶對選擇控制的信任，以及上下文是否真正減少日常工作中的解釋負擔。
items_flat.quote: ChatGPT can now remember your activity across the apps and websites on your computer. With Computer History in the desktop app, future interactions feel more personalized and require less explanation.
items_flat.quote_zh: ChatGPT 現在可以記住你在電腦上跨 App 與網站的活動。透過桌面版的 Computer History，未來互動會更個人化，也需要更少解釋。

items_flat.title_en: Hugging Face releases State of Open Models, Summer 2026 report
items_flat.title_zh: Hugging Face 發布《State of Open Models, Summer 2026》報告
items_flat.summary_en: Hugging Face published its State of Open Models Summer 2026 observations. Key findings include frontier models growing larger (especially from Chinese labs), small models still dominating real-world downloads, Qwen leading local inference and derivatives, and AI agents becoming a major force on the Hub.
items_flat.summary_zh: Hugging Face 發布《State of Open Models Summer 2026》觀察報告。主要發現包括前沿模型持續變大（尤其中國實驗室）、小模型仍主導實際下載量、Qwen 領先本地推理與衍生模型，以及 AI agent 成為 Hub 上的重要力量。
items_flat.analysis_en: The report quantifies the continued shift toward Chinese open-weight leadership in scale and community adoption, while underscoring that practical usage remains dominated by smaller, efficient models. It highlights the growing role of agents as consumers of open models.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 報告量化了中國開源權重在規模與社群採用上的持續領先，同時強調實際使用仍由較小、高效率模型主導。它也凸顯 agent 作為開源模型消費者的角色日益重要。
items_flat.quote: frontier models are getting larger, but small models still dominate real-world usage. Qwen leads local inference, followed by Gemma. AI agents are becoming a major force on the Hub
items_flat.quote_zh: 前沿模型持續變大，但小模型仍主導實際使用。Qwen 領先本地推理，其次是 Gemma。AI agent 正成為 Hub 上的主要力量

items_flat.title_en: NVIDIA and LG deepen partnership on humanoid robots using Isaac GR00T
items_flat.title_zh: NVIDIA 與 LG 深化合作，以 Isaac GR00T 打造人形機器人
items_flat.summary_en: LG and NVIDIA signed an MOU to develop a next-generation bipedal humanoid robot based on NVIDIA’s Isaac GR00T foundation model and Jetson Thor, targeting a Q1 2027 unveil. The collaboration also expands into AI infrastructure, physical AI, and robotics.
items_flat.summary_zh: LG 與 NVIDIA 簽署備忘錄，基於 NVIDIA Isaac GR00T 基礎模型與 Jetson Thor 開發下一代雙足人形機器人，目標 2027 年第一季亮相。合作也延伸至 AI 基礎設施、物理 AI 與機器人領域。
items_flat.analysis_en: The deal underscores NVIDIA’s push to embed its robotics stack into major hardware partners’ products. Success will depend on real-world reliability of GR00T-based systems and whether LG can differentiate on manufacturing and vertical integration.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 此合作凸顯 NVIDIA 將其機器人堆疊嵌入主要硬體夥伴產品的策略。成敗取決於 GR00T 系統的實際可靠性，以及 LG 能否在製造與垂直整合上做出差異化。
items_flat.quote: Great to welcome @LGE_Global Group Chairman Kwang-mo Koo and LG leaders to NVIDIA as we enter the next chapter of our collaboration. Together, we’re expanding our work across AI infrastructure, physical AI and robotics.
items_flat.quote_zh: 很高興歡迎 @LGE_Global 集團會長具光謨與 LG 領導層造訪 NVIDIA，共同開啟合作新篇章。我們將在 AI 基礎設施、物理 AI 與機器人領域擴大合作。
